title: Downtown Austin Scavenger Hunt Adventure
includes: One scavenger hunt tour for a team of 2-5 people
Smart phone - participants must have at least one smart phone per team with a U.S. cellular data service plan (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Maximum of 5 people per team - buy 3, get 2 people free
policies: Teams must book together in order to be included in the same adventure
Operates in all weather conditions so please dress appropriately
Follow directions on voucher to activate tour
Pricing is per individual but the team must book together - one voucher is valid for team of 2-5 people
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Turn Austin into a giant game board with this fun scavenger hunt adventure. This challenge combines the excitement of the Amazing Race with a three hour city walking tour. Guided from your smart phone, teams make their way among well known and overlooked gems of the city, solving clues and completing challenges, while learning local history. 

Note: Pricing is per individual but teams must book together in order to be included in the same adventure.
